name: Customer
description: Store comprehensive customer information and lifecycle stage tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for customer contact

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Customer's complete name

fields.name: companyName
fields.description: Name of the customer's company or organization

fields.name: lifecycleStage
fields.description: Current stage in customer journey (lead, prospect, customer, churned)

fields.name: source
fields.description: Attribution source of how customer was acquired

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when customer record was created

fields.name: stageUpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of last lifecycle stage transition

name: LifecycleStage
description: Defines customer lifecycle stage configurations with transition rules and stage-specific attributes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the lifecycle stage

fields.name: name
fields.description: Stage name (e.g., Lead, Prospect, Active, At Risk, Churned)

fields.name: sequenceOrder
fields.description: Numeric order defining the stage position in the lifecycle progression

fields.name: transitionCriteria
fields.description: Rules and conditions that define when a customer moves to this stage

fields.name: allowedNextStages
fields.description: List of stage IDs that can be transitioned to from this stage

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this lifecycle stage is currently active and available for use

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color code for visual representation in UI

relationships.description: Customers assigned to this lifecycle stage

name: CustomerSource
description: Track and categorize customer acquisition sources to support marketing attribution and source effectiveness analysis

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer source

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Name of the acquisition source (e.g., Google Ads, Referral, Website, Trade Show)

fields.name: sourceCategory
fields.description: High-level category of the source (e.g., Paid Advertising, Organic, Referral, Direct, Partner)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Additional details about the source or campaign

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this source is currently active for new customer acquisition

fields.name: createdDate
fields.description: Date when this source was added to the system

relationships.description: A customer source can be associated with multiple customers

name: Interaction
description: Records all customer interactions across multiple communication channels including calls, emails, and meetings

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the interaction

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer involved in this interaction

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of interaction (call, email, meeting, chat, etc.)

fields.name: interactionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the interaction occurred

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Detailed notes and summary of the interaction

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Result or outcome of the interaction

fields.name: nextSteps
fields.description: Planned follow-up actions or next steps

fields.name: followUpRequired
fields.description: Indicates if a follow-up task should be generated

relationships.description: Links interaction to the associated customer

name: FollowUpTask
description: Manages follow-up tasks and action items for customer engagement with assignment tracking, priority levels, and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the follow-up task

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer this task is associated with

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief title or summary of the follow-up task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the task and action items required

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: User ID or name of the person assigned to complete this task

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the task (Low, Medium, High, Urgent)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date and time when the task is due for completion

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (Pending, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled)

relationships.description: Each follow-up task belongs to one customer

name: Notification
description: Store and manage system notifications for users regarding status changes, overdue tasks, and important customer events

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user receiving the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (status_change, overdue_task, customer_event)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the notification (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: message
fields.description: Notification message content

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: ID of the related entity (Customer, Task, etc.)

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read by the user

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was created
